Plan the system before building it

Simulate the whole thermal path, boundary by boundary.

Selection, planning and design are informed by the whole loop: rack load, coolant temperatures, CDU approach, heat rejection and the heat you could reuse. Our concept simulator lets you pick a rack platform, a climate and a pipework layout, then watch junction temperature, flow, pressure drop and pPUE settle, and stress the design with load steps, pump loss or fouling.

Open the simulatorAll engineering tools

Concept model for planning and comparison. Not for equipment selection, acceptance or performance claims.
